visual: Sweetly scented pink flowers flushed white · deep pink buds · repeats spring to autumn
water: Evenly damp; never let it dry out at the root
soilWarning: Shelter from cold drying winds · resents root disturbance
prune: Barely prune · light tidy after a flush if it is needed at all
toxicity: All parts are harmful if eaten and the sap irritates skin. Wear gloves when handling.
cvs: trade name PINK FRAGRANCE; cultivar 'Blapink' PBR; also listed as Eternal Fragrance Pink
hardinessNote: H5 taken from the sibling ETERNAL FRAGRANCE ('Blafra') in the same hybrid group — see uncertain
resilience: long flowering season · compact · all parts harmful
uses: scented borders · entrances and paths · containers · small gardens
uncertain: Identified by Oscar as PINK FRAGRANCE after the photo was parked as an unidentified summer-flowering Daphne (VERIFY-QUEUE 44); the plant is NOT the deck's held Daphne bholua 'Jacqueline Postill', which flowers Jan-Mar

Hardiness could not be read off the RHS page for 'Blapink' from this environment (egress blocked). H5 is RHS's published rating for the sibling ETERNAL FRAGRANCE ('Blafra') in the same hybrid group; check it against the nursery label before this card is trusted on a bench
RHS describes the plant as compact 'to 90cm'; UK nursery sources commonly give about 1 m by 1 m, so 0.9-1.2 m was used for both dimensions
Flowering given as Apr-Oct from the sibling cultivar's published season; RHS describes Pink Fragrance only as flowering 'from spring until autumn'
